function Schemes({ user }) { const [open, setOpen] = useState(null); return (

🏛️ Government Schemes

Central & Tamil Nadu agricultural schemes — matched to your profile

✅ Your profile: {user.name} • {user.district} • {user.landSize||"?"} acres • {user.crops?.slice(0,3).join(", ")||"various crops"} — {SCHEMES.length} schemes available
{SCHEMES.map((s,i) => (
setOpen(open===i?null:i)}>
{s.name} {s.tag} {s.amount}
{s.desc}
● Active
{open === i && (
📄 Required Documents:
{s.docs.map(d => 📄 {d})}
🌐 Portal: {s.portal}
)} ))}
); }
